test_title: PYST 173: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 16th Nov,, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The most important / of all my goals / are to/ learn English.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'are to'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Using the **linking verb are** in the part ***'are to' ***violates *subject-verb agreement. *
 
• The subject of the sentence is **singular***** **- the person wants to learn English which is the most important of his goals. *
 
• Hence, we cannot use the **plural linking verb are **with a singular subject. 
 
• Hence, **option 3 **is the correct answer. 
 
• The sentence can be correct by using the **singular linking verb is. **

**Correct sentence__ - ***The most important / of all my goals / **is to**/ learn English.*
